messages:
tara: Hey team — heads up I need to be offline this weekend for a family emergency. Can someone pick up the weekend oncall (Sat night + Sun day) and cover the Monday morning handoff? I can do a weekday evening next week to swap.

I left a quick handoff below (short list only). Please @ me if you take it and I’ll update the rota/calendar. :pray:

- Services to watch: api-gateway, model-runner, batch-scheduler (inference).
- Risk: model-runner has a gradual mem growth on long sequences — we currently restart pods nightly at 04:00 UTC. If you see high RSS + OOMs, restarting the runner pod tends to clear it. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runner-leak
- Quick checks: health endpoints + queue backlog.

Quick commands:
```
# check pods + restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=model-runner -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount
# health check for gateway
curl -sS https://gateway.internal/health | jq .status
```

Also FYI there is a medium-priority SRE ticket (SRE-4821) about long-tail latency that might alert if p50->p95 jumps; don't panic, it's likely related to a single indexer job but worth watching.

chen: I can take Saturday night (22:00-06:00). Will update my calendar and take the pager. I know the runner-restart flow.

alex: I can do Sunday day shift and Monday morning handoff (08:00-12:00) if that helps — then tara you can swap for my Tue evening next week.

sam: If you want purely overnight coverage for Sun->Mon I can grab the 00:00-08:00 slot; otherwise alex + sam overlap would be fine too.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Please move shifts in the oncall rota UI and add a short note when you take coverage. See https://redwood.internal/oncall for instructions.

tara: Thanks Chen — really appreciate Sat night cover. Alex, if you can do Sunday day + Mon morning that would be perfect. Sam — thanks for offering, please stand by in case we need to move the overnight shift; I’ll confirm by EOD.

chen: Added note to rota: "Covering Sat 22:00-06:00 for tara (family emergency). Runner restart flow OK)" :white_check_mark:

alex: Done — added to calendar and set a Slack reminder for Mon 07:30 for handoff. I’ll check the SRE-4821 alert thresholds before bed.

sam: Cool — standing by, will take overnight if you need me to swap later. Good luck, tara. :heart:

tara: Thanks all. Two tiny extras: if alerting fires for "model-runner-memory" tag, try a rolling restart via our infra script: `infractl restart runner --region=us-west-2` (runbook steps first). If anything is noisy, escalate to @chen then @alex. I’ll DM any final patient ETA.

alex: Got it. I’ll also ping eng-sre if we see >3 restarts in 30m.

chen: I’ll check the nightly cron and add a temporary extra restart at 02:00 for Sat night just to be safe.

oncall-bot: Note: Shift ownership changed (tara -> chen on 2026-05-09 22:00 UTC).

tara: Leaving my laptop in case of urgent questions; otherwise I’m offline. Thanks everyone.
